from pathlib import Path


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
ROUTES = ROOT / "backend" / "modules" / "inteligencia_comercial" / "iscam_routes.py"


def source():
    return ROUTES.read_text(encoding="utf-8")


def test_iscam_openjson_guards_invalid_sync_sales_items_json():
    text = source()
    guarded = "CROSS APPLY OPENJSON(CASE WHEN ISJSON(s.items) = 1 THEN s.items ELSE N'[]' END) WITH ("
    assert guarded in text
    assert "CROSS APPLY OPENJSON(s.items) WITH (" not in text


def test_iscam_openjson_keeps_existing_comandas_schema_and_source_contract():
    text = source()
    assert "prod_id NVARCHAR(60) '$.id'" in text
    assert "prod_name NVARCHAR(250) '$.name'" in text
    assert "@iscam_router.get(\"/comandas\")" in text
    assert "FROM dbo.Sync_Sales s {_OPENJSON_ITEMS}" in text
